name: Kreebi AI Website Builder
author: Bipin Khatri

sections.description:
Kreebi AI Website Builder is the fastest free way to build stunning WordPress pages with AI. Describe the section you want in plain English, let the AI generate it, then click any section in the live preview to edit it right there. Perfect for landing pages, business websites, portfolios, and blog pages — no code, no shortcodes, no page-builder bloat.

It is free to start: you get daily free AI credits, enough for normal site development, with no credit card, no payment method, and no login required. Need more? You can go premium anytime for extra AI credits.

Built for speed, security, and clean design. Pages are stored as simple Markdown and rendered in an isolated, theme-safe layer, so your WordPress theme CSS can never break your AI-generated design. Only the components you actually use are loaded, keeping your pages lightweight and fast.

How it works

  1. Create a new WordPress Page and publish it (or save as draft).
  2. Hover the page under All Pages and click Edit with Kreebi Builder — also available in the Gutenberg toolbar and the front-end admin bar.
  3. Describe a section in the AI Builder chat to generate it instantly — hero, features, testimonials, pricing, FAQ, contact, and more.
  4. Click any section in the Live Preview to edit text inline, or refine the Markdown source in the Editor tab. Switch Laptop / Tablet / Phone preview, click Reload to re-render, then Save.

That is it. View your finished, mobile-responsive page on the front end.

Free to start, with daily free AI credits

Kreebi is a free AI website builder: install it, open the builder, and start generating with your daily free credits right away. The free credits are sufficient for normal site development. If you ever need heavier AI usage, you can go premium anytime for extra AI credits — but you never need a credit card, payment method, or login just to get started.

Key features for AI-powered page building

  • AI section generator – turn a single prompt into a complete, styled section. Iterate by chatting: regenerate, expand, shorten, or restyle.
  • Blog Page + Interactive Page modes – story-style articles with headlines, images and quotes, or clickable pages with tabs, accordions, sliders, buttons, forms, counters and scroll animations.
  • Visual live preview editing – click a section to select it, click its text again to edit inline. What you see is what your visitors get.
  • True client-view preview – the builder loads your exact page permalink (theme header, content, footer) inside the preview frame.
  • Responsive design controls – instant Laptop, Tablet and Phone preview. Mobile-first grids collapse to one column automatically.
  • Markdown + Container grids – clean, portable source with 1–4 column responsive grids, dividers, tables, quotes, lists, and image controls for alignment, size and aspect ratio.
  • Theme-safe isolated output – namespaced CSS layer plus per-page compiled CSS. Your theme never overrides your design, and your design never leaks into your theme.
  • Lightweight and fast – shared base styles load once; component CSS/JS loads only when that component is used on the page. Sanitized, SEO-friendly HTML output.
  • Works where you work – “Edit with Kreebi Builder” in Pages list, Gutenberg editor toolbar, and front-end admin bar.
  • Secure by design – builder access requires the unfiltered_html capability (Administrators and Editors on single-site installs). All front-end output is escaped and filtered with wp_kses.

Why choose Kreebi over Elementor, Divi or Gutenberg blocks?

Traditional drag-and-drop page builders make you assemble every row, column and widget by hand. Kreebi flips the workflow: describe it, generate it, refine it. You get a complete designer-quality starting point in seconds, then fine-tune visually instead of starting from a blank canvas.

Unlike heavy builders that load dozens of assets site-wide, Kreebi enqueues only what each page needs — so AI-built landing pages stay fast for visitors and perfect for Core Web Vitals and SEO.

Perfect for

  • Small businesses and startups that need a professional landing page today
  • Freelancers and agencies building client pages faster
  • Bloggers and creators publishing beautiful story-style articles
  • Anyone who wants an AI landing page generator, AI content generator, and visual page builder in one free WordPress plugin

Important notes

  • The builder edits Pages only.
  • Available to Administrators and Editors (users with the unfiltered_html capability).
  • Not compatible with WordPress Multisite. The plugin cannot be activated on a Multisite network.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the kreebi-ai-website-builder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Pages > Add New, give your page a title and click Publish (or Save draft).
  4. Go to Pages > All Pages, hover your page and click Edit with Kreebi Builder to launch the AI builder.
  5. Optional: open Kreebi AI > Settings to manage your backend Auth Token and Site API Token.
sections.faq:
What is Kreebi AI Website Builder?

Kreebi AI Website Builder is a free WordPress AI page builder plugin. You describe the section or landing page you want in plain English, the AI generates it, and you refine it visually with live preview click-to-edit — no coding required.

Can I use it for free?

Yes. Kreebi is free forever. You get daily free credits which are sufficient for normal site development, and you can go premium anytime for extra AI credits.

Do I need a credit card or payment method to start?

No. You do not need any payment method linked or any login to get started with the free credits. Just install the plugin and start building.

Do I need coding or design skills to use it?

No. If you can write a sentence, you can build a page. Describe your hero, features, testimonials, pricing or FAQ section, let the AI generate the design, then click the text to edit it. Advanced users can still fine-tune the Markdown source directly.

What can I build with it?

Landing pages, homepages, services pages, about pages, portfolios, pricing pages, blog-style articles, and full marketing pages. Each page is mobile-responsive with Laptop, Tablet and Phone preview built in.

Will it work with my WordPress theme?

Yes. Kreebi renders pages in an isolated, namespaced CSS layer and loads your exact page permalink in the preview, so your theme header and footer stay intact while your theme CSS can never break the AI-generated design.

Is the output SEO-friendly and fast?

Yes. Front-end output is clean, sanitized HTML with only the CSS/JS needed for that page. No shortcode soup, no site-wide builder bloat — great for page speed and search rankings.

Which content types and user roles are supported?

The builder edits Pages only and is available to Administrators and Editors (users with the unfiltered_html capability on single-site installs).

Is this plugin compatible with WordPress Multisite?

No. Kreebi AI Website Builder does not support WordPress Multisite and cannot be activated on a Multisite network.

Do I need an API key?

The AI backend connection is preconfigured. Advanced users can optionally set an Auth Token under Kreebi AI > Settings. The Site API Token shown there lets the AI service save generated content securely via the REST API.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Security hardening: capability checks, sanitized REST inputs, escaped front-end output, and restricted preview-frame messaging.
  • Improved true-page preview with header/footer intact and navigation locked inside the editor.
  • More reliable save flow with empty-submit safety net and clearer success notices.

1.0.3

  • Responsive style improvements across components.
  • Per-page compiled CSS so custom rules win without bloat.
  • Chat streaming and backend connection reliability improvements.

1.0.2

  • Markdown version re-release.
  • Added Parsedown credits.

1.0.1

  • Load assets through the WordPress enqueue system.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: AI Builder chat, live preview click-to-edit, Editor tab, responsive preview, and theme-safe rendering for Pages.
